title: Rivals of Ixalan Magic Story Alternate Endings

entities.name: Tishana
entities.description: A River Herald elder who, in the non-canon River Heralds ending, claims Orazca as the City of Golden Water.

entities.name: Huatli
entities.description: The Sun Empire warrior who leaves Orazca on an elder dinosaur.

entities.name: Emperor Apatzec III
entities.description: The emperor of the Sun Empire, whom Tishana distrusts.

entities.name: Vona of Iedo
entities.description: A vampire conquistador who, in the non-canon Legion of Dusk ending, claims Orazca and is eaten by a dinosaur.

entities.name: Saint Elenda
entities.description: The vampire saint who tells Vona to claim Orazca and sails east.

entities.name: Mavren Fein
entities.description: A vampire hierophant who begs Elenda's forgiveness.

entities.name: Queen Miralda
entities.description: The queen who sent Vona's expedition to conquer.

entities.name: Malcolm
entities.description: A siren of the Belligerent who becomes co-emperor of Orazca in the non-canon pirate ending.

entities.name: Breeches
entities.description: A goblin of the Belligerent who becomes co-emperor of Orazca in the non-canon pirate ending.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A mind mage whose voice spoke to Malcolm and Breeches.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: The crew's captain, whose orders are to let her go.

entities.name: Orazca
entities.description: The golden city claimed in each alternate ending.

entities.name: Immortal Sun
entities.description: The artifact that is gone from Orazca.

entities.name: The Belligerent
entities.description: The pirate ship whose crew loots Orazca.

entities.name: River Heralds
entities.description: The merfolk who settle Orazca in the non-canon River Heralds ending.

entities.name: Sun Empire
entities.description: The empire whose claim is canon.

entities.name: Legion of Dusk
entities.description: The vampire army for whom Vona claims Orazca.

entities.name: Deeproot Tree
entities.description: The River Herald community Tishana will summon to Orazca.

events.summary: Tishana is left alone in Orazca after Huatli departs (non-canon River Heralds ending).
events.quote: Tishana watched as Huatli departed on the back of the elder dinosaur.

events.summary: Tishana distrusts the Sun Empire under Emperor Apatzec III.
events.quote: The Sun Empire was still ruled by Emperor Apatzec III, after all.

events.summary: Tishana commands the elementals to guard every entrance against non-merfolk forces.
events.quote: Tishana willed them to stand guard, to be ready for any non-merfolk force that may try to enter Orazca.

events.summary: Tishana resolves to settle the River Heralds permanently and rename the city the City of Golden Water.
events.quote: The River Heralds would settle here permanently

events.summary: Vona refuses to return to Torrezon empty-handed (non-canon Legion of Dusk ending).
events.quote: I will not return to Torrezon empty-handed,

events.summary: Saint Elenda tells Vona to claim Orazca and sails east.
events.quote: Claim Orazca for your own. I will sail to the East.

events.summary: Vona returns and claims Orazca for the Legion of Dusk.
events.quote: Orazca had been claimed for the Legion of Dusk!

events.summary: A giant dinosaur eats Vona in the plaza.
events.quote: Vona did not have time to scream as the dinosaur snapped her up into its jaws.

events.summary: Malcolm and Breeches, told by Jace to let Vraska go, find Orazca empty (non-canon pirate ending).
events.quote: Captain's orders are to let her go, Breeches.

events.summary: Breeches notes everyone else has left Orazca.
A week later the Belligerent's crew carouses in Azor's old sanctum on looted gold, with Malcolm and Breeches as co-emperors.
events.quote: Will you join me for ale and cards, Co-Emperor Breeches?

relations.note: She would summon her people to settle Orazca.
relations.quote: The River Heralds would settle here permanently

relations.note: The queen sent Vona's expedition to conquer.
relations.quote: Queen Miralda sent us here to conquer

relations.note: He begs her forgiveness and follows her.
relations.quote: Saint Elenda turned and began walking again without another word, and Mavren Fein followed.

relations.note: Co-emperors of Orazca in this ending.
relations.quote: Will you join me for ale and cards, Co-Emperor Breeches?

relations.note: She distrusts humans and guards against non-merfolk forces.
relations.quote: Orazca may have been made by them, but it did not belong to them.
